## Appearance

Lauretta is a fat, placid-looking eight-year-old child. She has fair hair that hangs down in two long braids.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P35](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0035)_

## Personality

Lauretta is a very nice and fat child. She maintains a placid appearance.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P35](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0035)_

Lauretta was a fat, placid-looking child who maintained an irreproachable record of good behavior in church from the time she was a six-month-old infant.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P35](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0035)_
